sources.title_zh: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 不只是產生影像，它是在畫畫
sources.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
sources.title_original: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
sources.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton. The article Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 的運作方式與其他 AI 模型不同，它不會產生影像。這個語言模型不會去計算像素，而是編寫 Python 程式碼，在虛擬畫布上配置數十萬個模擬筆觸，並具備刷毛質感與顏料塗布效果。Anthropic 員工 Jake Eaton 表示，單單一個逼真的停車場場景就大約花費了 700,000 個筆觸。

sources.title_en: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.title_original: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.summary: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. Author Mike Major cautions against jumping to conclusions, however, noting that business cycle shifts and remote work trends could also explain the numbers. The article Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 澳洲央行發現早期跡象顯示，人工智慧正在衝擊高度曝險職位（如軟體開發和客戶服務）的年輕入門員工。自 ChatGPT 推出以來，這些領域中 15 至 24 歲族群的職缺與就業率下降幅度，比年長員工更為劇烈。不過，作家麥克・梅傑（Mike Major）警告切勿妄下定論，並指出景氣迴圈轉變和遠距工作趨勢也可能是這些資料的原因。

sources.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a11 datasette-llm is the intermediate plugin for Datasette that supports configuring LLMs for use with other Datasette plugins. This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so you can configure Datasette to use an LLM hosted anywhere that talks the OpenAI pseudo-standard web protocol. This means that if you're running local models with LM Studio or Ollama or llama.cpp (which just hit v1.0.0 ) you can run Datasette via uvx like this: And you'll get a local server running a Datasette Agent instance powered by your local model! Tags: uv , datasette-agent , llm , datasette , llms , ai , generative-ai
sources.summary_zh: 發布：datasette-llm 0.1a11 datasette-llm 是 Datasette 的中介外掛程式，支援設定 LLMs 以與其他 Datasette 外掛程式搭配使用。此版本新增了對 OpenAI 相容端點的支援，因此您可以將 Datasette 設定為使用託管在任何支援 OpenAI 虛擬標準網路協定之處的 LLM。這意味著如果您正在使用 LM Studio、Ollama 或 llama.cpp（剛推出 v1.0.0 版本）執行本機模型，您可以透過 uvx 執行 Datasette，就像這樣：然後您就會獲得一個本機伺服器，並執行由您的本機模型驅動的 Datasette Agent 實例！標籤：uv , datasette-agent , llm , datasette , llms , ai , generative-ai

events.news_summary: Anthropic的Claude Fable 5.2透過撰寫Python程式碼繪製畫筆筆觸來生成圖像，而非計算像素。

sources.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 不只是產生影像，它是在畫畫 / Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
sources.title_zh: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 不只是產生影像，它是在畫畫
sources.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
sources.title_original: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
sources.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton. The article Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 的運作方式與其他 AI 模型不同，它不會產生影像。這個語言模型不會去計算像素，而是編寫 Python 程式碼，在虛擬畫布上配置數十萬個模擬筆觸，並具備刷毛質感與顏料塗布效果。Anthropic 員工 Jake Eaton 表示，單單一個逼真的停車場場景就大約花費了 700,000 個筆觸。

sources.summary: Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. This means that if you're running local models with LM Studio or Ollama or llama.cpp (which just hit v1.0.0 ) you can run Datasette via uvx like this: And you'll get a local server running a Datasette Agent instance powered by your local model! sources.title: 澳洲央行發現人工智慧首當其衝影響年輕員工，特別是在軟體與客戶服務領域 / Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.title_zh: 澳洲央行發現人工智慧首當其衝影響年輕員工，特別是在軟體與客戶服務領域
sources.title_en: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.title_original: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
sources.summary: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. Author Mike Major cautions against jumping to conclusions, however, noting that business cycle shifts and remote work trends could also explain the numbers. The article Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 澳洲央行發現早期跡象顯示，人工智慧正在衝擊高度曝險職位（如軟體開發和客戶服務）的年輕入門員工。自 ChatGPT 推出以來，這些領域中 15 至 24 歲族群的職缺與就業率下降幅度，比年長員工更為劇烈。不過，作家麥克・梅傑（Mike Major）警告切勿妄下定論，並指出景氣迴圈轉變和遠距工作趨勢也可能是這些資料的原因。

Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU

Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. On Terminal Bench, it scores 88.4 points, landing just behind Claude Opus 5. The sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips, and Meituan makes no mention of Nvidia GPUs.
